plain_description: Candle lets you deploy machine learning models in production without the bloat of Python frameworks — cutting server costs and startup times. You can run LLMs, image generators, and speech recognition on CPU or GPU with a small Rust binary. It is built for serverless inference, so you get fast scaling and lower infrastructure overhead.
technical_description: Candle is a minimalist machine learning framework written in Rust that exposes a PyTorch-like tensor API. It implements CPU, CUDA, and WASM backends with optional MKL, Accelerate, and cuDNN acceleration for optimized performance. The framework supports model training and inference, loading models from safetensors, GGUF/GGML, ONNX, and PyTorch formats. It includes a transformer model library, flash attention kernels, ONNX runtime evaluation, and quantization using llama.cpp-compatible types. Integration is via Cargo crate dependency. The project ships example implementations covering LLMs (LLaMA, Mistral, Falcon, Phi, Gemma, Qwen), image generation (Stable Diffusion, Wuerstchen), speech recognition (Whisper), text-to-speech (MetaVoice, Parler-TTS), translation (Marian-MT), code generation (StarCoder), and computer vision (YOLO, SAM).
title: Candle
